dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Adventure Challenge

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Duel

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: Eh, is it really that simple? On second thought...

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: No problem. Next time. Few things work out the way we want on the first try.

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: That's amazing. Well, next time I'll make some snacks and we'll have fun while we eat.

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: I often play a few rounds with the regulars of Wanmin Restaurant. The peppers are still pretty spicy, hahaha.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Any recommendations?

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: Black-Back Perch Stew is our signature dish. Sure, you might find it in other restaurants too, but I guarantee you it won't taste anywhere near as good as ours.

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: A generous helping of fish, cooked with a special blend of chili oil made from Jueyun Chili and Violetgrass. Beautifully tender, bursting with flavor. I've never had a single complaint from anyone who's eaten it!

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: ...It's a little spicy for some people, though, so not all would eat it in the first place.

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: Why not have a taste? If you like it, you can always buy some more.

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: Here for the Wanmin Restaurant experience? Hi, I'm Chef Mao. Everyone in Chihu Rock will have heard of me.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Can I get food to-go?

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: Sure! What do you feel like having?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me more about the Wanmin Restaurant.

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: Well, I'm the chef. I may not be quite the culinary legend that my daughter is, but you can be sure the Wanmin Restaurant is a cut above all those time-honored brands you see around!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: Take care now. Do visit again when you're feeling hungry!

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: Which type of cuisine do you do?

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: Type of cuisine? Oh, we don't bother ourselves with that kind of thing here.

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: Li style and Yue style are all Zhongyuan Chop Suey to us.

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: We just concern ourselves with making the most delicious food imaginable using everyday ingredients, universally loved flavors, and truly excellent cooking.

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: Food exists to feed the hungry. It's that simple. These people who go putting systems and frameworks around everything are just amateurs that are overcompensating... They don't understand what cooking is really all about.

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: Your daughter?

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: That's right — Xiangling! My dear daughter, and my best apprentice ever.

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: I only taught Xiangling how to cook so that she could inherit the Wanmin Restaurant from me one day. I had no idea she'd turn out to be such a pro. Her abilities far exceed my own.

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: But she's more than just an excellent chef. She has a real gift for innovation — she's constantly creating all these wonderful new dishes. That really sets her apart from what the time-honored brands do. And it makes her dishes all the more special for people who are used to traditional cuisine.

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: I started to worry that the restaurant might be too constricting for her. So I sent her off for a while to do some exploring and perfect her art.

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: If anyone is going to revolutionize Liyue cuisine in the future, it'll be her. No doubt about it!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How's business going?

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: Oh, come on. How could business here at Wanmin Restaurant's be slow?

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: One taste of our handiwork will turn most people into regulars.

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: ...Speaking of regulars, we've had a young lady with a strange headdress come in pretty often lately. The vegetarian dishes on our menu seem quite to her taste.

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: But I've noticed that she only ever orders the vegetarian dishes, and in very small amounts, too.

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: I gave her a larger portion out of sympathy, but she seemed quite reluctant to accept it. Is she trying to maintain her physique? Young ladies nowadays really are serious about such things...
